svg.title: ASCII Camera — core workflow

text.font-family: Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Hiragino Sans GB', 'Microsoft YaHei', 'Noto Sans CJK SC', 'Noto Sans SC', sans-serif

svg.text: Three paths share one set of settings: the main view renders every frame, preset cards render the demo at ~10 fps, exports only read the final canvas.

svg.text: A settings change is written to the renderer and appears on the next frame — no new camera request, no new loop, recording continues.

svg.text: Frame rate drops (down to 4 fps) when the page starts dropping frames, so the main view keeps priority.

svg.text: If the rewrite fails, the original recording is delivered with a notice.

text.font-family: Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Hiragino Sans GB', 'Microsoft YaHei', 'Noto Sans CJK SC', 'Noto Sans SC', sans-serif

svg.text: While recording, presets, language, panels, fullscreen and camera on/off can all change; the video resolution stays fixed. Video and GIF recording are mutually exclusive.
